question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.
sql:
-- Step 4: Full query - using rental table for rental count, payment table for total amount
WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    rental_id,
    payment_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date ASC) AS rn
  FROM payment
),
first_rentals AS (
  SELECT fpc.customer_id, fpc.rental_id
  FROM first_payment_per_customer fpc
  WHERE fpc.rn = 1
),
first_movie_info AS (
  SELECT 
    fr.customer_id,
    f.rating
  FROM first_rentals fr
  JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_amounts AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fmi.rating,
    AVG(ca.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie_info fmi
JOIN customer_amounts ca ON fmi.customer_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN customer_rentals cr ON fmi.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY fmi.rating
ORDER BY fmi.rating

WITH first_payment_per_customer AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    rental_id,
    payment_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_date ASC) AS rn
  FROM payment
),
first_rentals AS (
  SELECT fpc.customer_id, fpc.rental_id
  FROM first_payment_per_customer fpc
  WHERE fpc.rn = 1
),
first_movie_info AS (
  SELECT 
    fr.customer_id,
    f.rating
  FROM first_rentals fr
  JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_amounts AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
  FROM rental
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fmi.rating,
    AVG(ca.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount,
    AVG(cr.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie_info fmi
JOIN customer_amounts ca ON fmi.customer_id = ca.customer_id
JOIN customer_rentals cr ON fmi.customer_id = cr.customer_id
GROUP BY fmi.rating
ORDER BY fmi.rating
